info.title: Shah Agriculture Information Library (SAIL) API
info.description:
Versioned REST API for the SAIL / Krishi platform.

**Authentication** uses HttpOnly cookies (`sail_at` access token, `sail_rt` refresh token) set by `POST /auth/login`.
A `Bearer` access token is also accepted for API clients. The access token lasts 15 minutes; call `POST /auth/refresh` to rotate it.

**Generic resources** expose a public read-only listing at `/{resource}` and full CRUD at `/admin/{resource}`.
Write operations require one of `SUPER_ADMIN`, `EDITOR`, `CONTENT_MANAGER`; user and role management requires `SUPER_ADMIN`.

All responses use the envelope `{ "success": boolean, "data"?: ..., "message"?: string, "meta"?: {...}, "details"?: ... }`.

post.description: Sets the `sail_at` (access) and `sail_rt` (refresh) HttpOnly cookies and returns the access token.
Uses the `sail_rt` cookie, rotates it and issues a new access token.
Revokes all sessions and clears auth cookies on success.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: At least 2 characters; shorter queries return an empty result.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Filter by entity name, e.g. Book.

post.summary: Preview or commit a book import
post.description: Without `commit=true` this validates the file and returns a preview. With `commit=true` rows are written in a transaction.

parameters.name: duplicatePolicy
parameters.description: What to do with rows that match an existing book (by ISBN or name+author).

Search.name: search
Search.description: Case-insensitive search across the resource search fields.

Sort.name: sort
Sort.description: Field to sort by. Unknown fields fall back to the default order.

BadRequest.description: Validation failed or the request was malformed

Unauthorized.description: Authentication required or the session has expired

Conflict.description: A record with the same unique value already exists

Resource.description: A resource record. Field set depends on the resource; see the model definitions in backend/prisma/schema.prisma.

ResourceWrite.description: Create/update payload. Required and optional fields are validated per resource with Zod; see docs/API.md for the field table.
